# ffxf_load_balancer_listener (Resource)

Opens a load-balancer listener and manages its HTTP(S) routing rules. TCP listeners do not support rules.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (Number)
- `port` (Number)
- `protocol` (String) http, https, or tcp.

### Optional

- `default_pool` (Number) Default pool ID, or null to return 503 for unmatched HTTP requests.
- `redirect_https` (Boolean) For HTTPS listeners, redirect HTTP requests from port 80.
- `rules` (Attributes List) Complete ordered routing rule set. Each rule needs a hostname, a path prefix, or both. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `sources` (List of String) Allowed IPv4/IPv6 addresses or CIDRs; empty or null permits everyone.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Required:

- `pool` (Number)

Optional:

- `hostname` (String)
- `path_prefix` (String)
